title: Sugar Pie
hookLine: Canadian-inspired sugar pie with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Sugar Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9-inch pie dish. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {m52931_1}, {m52931_2}, {m52931_3}, and {m52931_4} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure brown sugar first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Sugar Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: Place the brown sugar and butter in a mixing bowl, and beat them together with an electric mixer until creamy and very well combined, without lumps. Beat in eggs, one at a time, incorporating the first egg before adding the next one. Add the vanilla extract and salt; beat the flour in, a little at a time, and then the milk, making a creamy batter. Pour the batter into the prepared pie dish. Incorporate {m52931_5}, {m52931_6}, and {m52931_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Sugar Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake in the preheated oven for 35 minutes; remove pie, and cover the rim with aluminum foil to prevent burning. Return to oven, and bake until the middle sets and the top forms a crusty layer, about 15 more minutes. Let the pie cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Sugar Pie to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 6 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
